about: In-game checks. result is pending until run in the real game; a release needs every row passed. how says what to do, expected what must be seen (log line or screenshot).

rows.how: Launch Brotato via Steam with boot + mod installed
rows.expected: modloader.log: 'Initializing -> HueBrotato-HuePotato' and extensions installed

rows.how: Launch with Hue installed
rows.expected: huepotato.log: Hue found and every hue_assets row loaded

rows.how: Open character select
rows.expected: Hue Potato card with Hue's hair/ear/eyes icon and the 6 effect lines

rows.how: Start a run as Hue Potato
rows.expected: Dark potato with Hue's hair, ear and eyes in the arena

rows.how: Hold right click, point at a slice, release
rows.expected: Time slows, wheel with owned colours and Hue symbols, chime; floor turns that colour

rows.how: Pick the colour of nearby enemies
rows.expected: Those enemies and their bullets fade to ghosts, deal no damage, take no hits; weapons aim elsewhere

rows.how: Play to wave 3
rows.expected: Orange fragment appears; collecting it adds Orange to the wheel, plays Hue's fragment sound and Mum's Orange letter with subtitles

rows.how: Wave 1 and wave 3
rows.expected: Village music then Waterfall music from Hue; region banner with Hue's map icon

rows.how: Shop after a wave
rows.expected: Hue items can appear with Hue icons; buying one applies its stats

rows.how: Play a wave as another character
rows.expected: No colours, no wheel, normal Brotato music

rows.how: Launch with the Hue path pointed at an empty folder
rows.expected: Title screen says Hue is needed; Hue Potato is not offered; no errors

rows.how: Save a Hue Potato run, start Brotato once without the mod active (Hue missing), then start it again
rows.expected: No engine ERROR naming mods-unpacked; the next start still has mods enabled

rows.how: Put a second test mod zip in mods/ beside Hue Potato (Brotatogether also loaded from the Workshop)
rows.expected: Each mod initialised exactly once; boot logs which zips it handed over and which it skipped

rows.how: The second test mod also extends main.gd and tints enemies and the floor
rows.expected: Both extensions run; Hue Potato restores the other mod's tint and floor colour instead of white

rows.how: Set hue_music, mum_letters and hue_items_in_shop to false in huepotato.cfg
rows.expected: Brotato's music keeps playing, no letters, no Hue items in the pool; the wheel still works

rows.how: Change colour with Q/E during a wave
rows.expected: A wave of the new colour sweeps out from Hue Potato

rows.how: Start a Hue Potato run (the Laser Ring is the starting weapon) and play waves, switching colours
rows.expected: Hue's laser cannons orbit the potato joined by beams in the colours found; beams zap enemies they touch; a beam of the background colour fades and doesn't hit

rows.how: Install and Play from the Melty app
rows.expected: Brotato starts with the mod loaded (same log lines as t_boot)

rows.how: Play Hue Potato waves with the probe recording every hit (no invulnerability)
rows.expected: Enemies of a visible colour hurt Hue Potato; enemies and bullets of the background colour never do

rows.how: Start at wave 3+ (or spawn one with the probe) and stand in a live gate, then switch to its colour
rows.expected: A gate warms up faintly, then a coloured beam spans the arena between two of Hue's cannons; it hurts Hue Potato unless the background is its colour

rows.how: Start at wave 7+ (or spawn one with the probe)
rows.expected: A coloured skull boulder's path shows, then it rolls across and hurts Hue Potato unless the background is its colour

rows.how: Play a Hue Potato wave until trees appear
rows.expected: Trees are Hue's coloured crates; a crate of the background colour fades and can't be hit; breaking one plays Hue's crate sound

rows.how: Start a run; reach wave 3; win a run
rows.expected: Mum's intro then Aqua letter at the start; Water letter at wave 3, the Orange letter waits its turn; her last letter and PS on winning

rows.how: Reach wave 20
rows.expected: Dr Grey's banner and Hue's DrGreyAppears music; the region music dips under it

rows.how: Play a Hue Potato wave
rows.expected: Hue's dust motes drift over the floor under the potatoes and enemies
